faqs.question: What is the Ariete® Series used for?

faqs.question: How many models are in the Ariete® range?
faqs.answer: 16 models, from the Ariete 2006 through the Ariete 5400, covering a wide range of flow rates and pressures.

faqs.question: What is the maximum flow rate available?
faqs.answer: Up to 80,000 l/h, on the Ariete 5400 at its lowest pressure setting.

faqs.question: What high-efficiency options are available?
faqs.answer: NanoValve®, ReFlow, AirFlow, and PureFlow, each aimed at reducing power, water, or oil consumption during continuous production.

faqs.question: Can the homogenizer be customized?
faqs.answer: Yes, more than 300 customization options are available across process, transmission, and utility configurations.

faqs.question: What certifications does the Ariete® Series meet?
faqs.answer: CE, USDA, FDA, 3-A, ATEX, EHEDG, and cGMP, covering food safety, hazardous-area, hygienic design, and pharmaceutical manufacturing standards.

faqs.question: Is an aseptic design available?
faqs.answer: Yes, an aseptic design option is available, alongside complete documentation for pharmaceutical applications.

faqs.question: Can the system run automated or remote control?
faqs.answer: Yes, a fully automated and remote control option is available.

faqs.question: Is the Ariete® Series suitable for viscous or abrasive products?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's built to handle abrasive and viscous products reliably in continuous processing.

longForm.heroHook: The largest capacity. The highest pressure. The lowest cost to own.
longForm.heroLead: Choosing a high-pressure homogenizer usually means trading capacity for cost, or reliability for flexibility. Ariete® refuses that trade-off, delivering the largest capacity and highest pressure on the market while holding the lowest total cost of ownership through superior pump efficiency. Every machine is built in-house from premium components, giving full traceability and consistent quality control across the range. Over 300 customization options shape each unit around the specific process, transmission, and utility requirements of dairy, beverage, food, pharmaceutical, chemical, biotech, and cosmetic production, while high-efficiency add-ons like NanoValve®, ReFlow, AirFlow, and PureFlow cut power, water, and oil consumption further.

sections.description: Ariete Series product information: model range, pressure and flow capacity, and industry certifications.
body: Every Ariete® machine is manufactured in-house using premium brand components, giving full traceability of parts and consistent quality control across the range.
The lineup offers the largest capacity and highest pressure available on the market, backed by superior pump operational efficiency that keeps total cost of ownership low.
High-efficiency options, NanoValve®, ReFlow, AirFlow, and PureFlow, install directly onto the base machine, cutting further costs in power, water, and oil across continuous production.

More than 300 customization options let each unit get shaped around specific process needs, transmission requirements, and utility connections, producing a genuinely unique configuration per customer.
The range covers dairy, food, beverage, pharmaceutical, chemical, biotech, and cosmetic industries, all from the same underlying platform.
Every machine meets EU CE safety standards, alongside USDA, FDA, 3-A, ATEX, EHEDG, and cGMP certifications and guidelines.
16 models span the range, from smaller units suited to lower flow rates to the 5400, reaching up to 80,000 l/h at its lowest pressure setting.

sections.title: Choosing the Right Model
sections.description: Flow rate and operating pressure trade off directly across the Ariete® lineup, higher pressure settings reduce achievable flow rate on every model, so the right choice depends on which side of that trade-off the process actually needs. Smaller models like the Ariete 2006 and 3006 suit lower-volume production, topping out around 1,000 l/h at their lowest pressure setting. Mid-range models, the 3030 through 3160 series, scale up substantially, with the 3160 reaching 22,000 l/h at its lowest pressure point. The largest models, 5132 through 5400, are built for high-volume industrial lines, with the 5400 reaching up to 80,000 l/h. Every model in the range can be paired with the same customization options and high-efficiency add-ons, so scaling up in flow rate doesn't mean losing configuration flexibility.

sections.title: Certified for Regulated Industries
sections.description: Regulated industries need documentation and certification as much as raw performance, and Ariete® is built to satisfy both from the same platform.
body: Every unit is designed to EU CE safety standards, alongside USDA, FDA, 3-A, ATEX, EHEDG, and cGMP certifications and guidelines, covering food safety, hazardous-area operation, hygienic design, and pharmaceutical manufacturing standards in a single compliance stack.

Pharmaceutical customers specifically get a complete documentation package alongside an aseptic design option, addressing sterile processing requirements directly. Full traceability of parts, guaranteed by in-house manufacturing, supports audit and compliance needs beyond the certifications themselves.
